```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(".", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"), local = TRUE)
ReportExtreme <- function(caseID, resultantID) {
  Row <- Calculation$extrema[
    Calculation$extrema$caseID == caseID &
      Calculation$extrema$resultantID == resultantID &
      Calculation$extrema$statisticID == "absolute-maximum",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (nrow(Row) != 1L || !is.finite(Row$value)) {
    stop("Missing resultant: ", caseID, ".", resultantID)
  }
  Row$value
}
ReportAashtoCheck <- function(checkID) {
  Row <- Calculation$aashto$checks[
    Calculation$aashto$checks$checkID == checkID,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (nrow(Row) != 1L || !is.finite(Row$utilization)) {
    stop("Missing AASHTO check: ", checkID)
  }
  Row
}
RemainingThicknessLossRatio <- 1 -
  Calculation$section$remainingBaseThicknessMm /
    Calculation$section$designBaseThicknessMm
SensitivitySteel <- utils::read.csv(
  Calculation$paths$sensitivitySteelExtrema,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
SensitivityAashto <- utils::read.csv(
  Calculation$paths$sensitivityAashtoChecks,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
SensitivityModuli <- sort(unique(SensitivitySteel$modulusMPa))
if (length(SensitivityModuli) < 2L) {
  stop("The sensitivity products require at least two moduli.")
}
SensitivityFirst <- SensitivityModuli[1L]
SensitivityLast <- SensitivityModuli[length(SensitivityModuli)]
SensitivityModuliSentence <- paste(
  paste(head(SensitivityModuli, -1L), collapse = ", "),
  tail(SensitivityModuli, 1L),
  sep = " y "
)
SensitivitySteelValue <- function(caseID, resultantID, modulus) {
  Value <- SensitivitySteel$value[
    SensitivitySteel$caseID == caseID &
      SensitivitySteel$resultantID == resultantID &
      SensitivitySteel$modulusMPa == modulus
  ]
  if (length(Value) != 1L || !is.finite(Value)) {
    stop("Missing steel sensitivity value: ", caseID, ".", resultantID)
  }
  Value
}
SensitivitySteelReductionPct <- function(caseID, resultantID) {
  100 * (1 -
    SensitivitySteelValue(caseID, resultantID, SensitivityLast) /
      SensitivitySteelValue(caseID, resultantID, SensitivityFirst))
}
SensitivityAashtoConstant <- all(tapply(
  SensitivityAashto$utilization,
  SensitivityAashto$checkID,
  function(x) diff(range(x))
) < 1e-9)
SensitivitySeamU <- unique(formatCalculationFixed(
  SensitivityAashto$utilization[SensitivityAashto$checkID == "seam"],
  2L
))
```

# Verificación del liner de acero {#sec-calculation-steel}

Este capítulo verifica el liner de acero existente con el perfil corrugado y
el espesor remanente del escenario de cálculo. Determina sus propiedades y
rigideces, obtiene las distribuciones de fuerza circunferencial, momento y
corte para ambos límites de interfaz, y contrasta el empuje circunferencial
con los controles de pared, pandeo, costura, flexibilidad y tapada. El objetivo
es identificar los estados que gobiernan y los datos de inspección que deben
confirmarse para la evaluación definitiva de la estructura existente.
